title: MIDB: Multilingual Instruction Data Booster for Enhancing Cultural Equality in Multilingual Instruction Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the models' cultural understanding and localization capabilities using the BLEnD benchmark, which tests knowledge of daily life across diverse cultures by prompting the model to answer as a native and automatically verifying if the output matches culturally-specific entities.

Assessing English-centric linguistic biases and machine translation defects using LLM-as-judge and human expert evaluations on localized multilingual versions of AlpacaEval and MT-Bench across 16 languages.
